## Summary

Describe what this changes and why it improves VisualRefinery.

## Where does the change belong?

- [ ] Core workflow (`SKILL.md`)
- [ ] Artifact-specific reference
- [ ] Domain profile
- [ ] Visual design reference
- [ ] QA / validation
- [ ] Example / documentation
- [ ] Repository infrastructure

## Validation

- [ ] `python scripts/validate_skill.py` passes.
- [ ] Relevant links and bundled-resource paths were checked.
- [ ] `SKILL.md` remains at or below 500 lines.
- [ ] User-visible behavior changes are reflected in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Evals were added or updated if behavior changed materially.
- [ ] The change does not introduce a personal preference into the domain-agnostic core.
- [ ] New dependencies, if any, are necessary and explained.

## Notes for reviewers

Call out trade-offs, uncertain areas, or screenshots / example outputs that help evaluate the change.
